# Navimower Map Card 0.3.1

Navimower Map Card 0.3.1 is the cumulative stable release of the 0.3.1 beta line. It is built directly on 0.3.0 and already contains the complete beta1-beta6 implementation; no beta release needs to be installed first.

## Notifications

0.3.1 adds the integrated Notifications experience introduced and refined during the beta line.

- The card auto-detects the Navimower **Latest notification** sensor and shows a Notifications label plus bell in the header.
- Any retained unread notification makes the header state Navimow orange; otherwise it remains neutral.
- Notification bodies are collapsed by default. Clicking a title expands or collapses the body, while unread rows also expose **Mark as read**.
- **Mark all as read** is available whenever at least one retained message is unread.
- The list is vertically scrollable and the visual editor/YAML option `notification_count` controls how many retained rows are shown, from 1 to 10, with a default of 5.
- `notification_mark_read_on_open` remains optional and defaults to `false`.
- The card calls only Home Assistant `navimower.mark_notification_read` and `navimower.mark_all_notifications_read` actions. It never talks directly to the Navimow cloud and never fakes read state locally; refreshed integration state remains authoritative.
- The same UI works with the merged vendor and Navimower-local notification timeline supplied by Navimower integration 0.4.2.

The notification panel and local notification read flow were exercised during the 0.3.1 / Navimower 0.4.2 beta cycle.

## Dedicated Resume control

0.3.1 separates **Resume** from **Mow** when the installed Navimower integration exposes `navimower.resume`.

- When Resume is available and the mower is paused, docked, or charging, **Resume** and **Mow** are shown side by side.
- Resume calls only `navimower.resume`; it sends no zone selection and does not start a new card-side mowing flow.
- **Mow** remains the explicit new/restart mowing action and opens the normal zone-aware Mow dialog when the dedicated Resume action exists.
- Older Navimower versions that do not expose `navimower.resume` retain the previous paused-Mow compatibility behavior.
- A docked/charging Resume button indicates that the action is available, not that the card can prove the vendor still retains an unfinished task. The actual retained-task behavior remains mower/firmware dependent.

Navimower integration **0.4.2 or later** is recommended for the complete 0.3.1 notification-read and Resume feature set.

## Header and editor refinements

- The configured card title now has its own header row, with History, Notifications, and Schedule on a separate wrapping action row.
- `show_title` is available in YAML and the visual editor and defaults to `true`.
- The visual editor keeps the Mower entity/Auto-detect and Title/Show title controls in balanced General-section columns.
- **Live trail point cap** remains available for the browser-side active/fallback trail and does not limit completed mowed-area history.

## Single-runtime cleanup

The final beta removed the historical core + patch-loader chain. Stable 0.3.1 keeps that cleaned architecture unchanged:

```text
src/navimower-map-card.js
dist/navimower-map-card.js
```

- `src/` contains one cumulative runtime source.
- `dist/` contains one generated HACS runtime file and is rebuilt from scratch.
- `dist/navimower-map-card.js` must remain byte-for-byte identical to the source.
- The build and layout guard reject extra runtime JavaScript files and version-specific local loader imports.
- HACS uses the stable filename `navimower-map-card.js` for both prereleases and stable releases.
- Historical beta implementations remain in Git commits, tags, and releases instead of accumulating as production runtime files on `main`.

This cleanup changes repository structure only; it does not remove the map, history, daily-trail, VF-off, Schedule, notification, or Resume behavior already present in beta5.

## Compatibility

- Existing card YAML and entity auto-discovery remain compatible.
- Existing map/history rendering, daily trails, completed-session renders, Schedule editor, Mow/Pause/Dock controls, VF-off visibility, zoom/navigation, and visual settings are retained.
- Existing dashboards do not need an intermediate beta installation before upgrading from 0.3.0 to 0.3.1.
- HACS continues to install the single `dist/navimower-map-card.js` runtime.

0.3.1 is the stable promotion of the tested 0.3.1-beta6 runtime; there is no separate beta merge or runtime rewrite in the stable release.
